title: Rabbi Abba bar Aivu
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 42:4: “Rabbi Berekhyah said in the name of Rabbi Chelbo, in the name of Rav Chanan (or Anan) bar Yosef, in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Aivu.” He is likewise mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 5:5. Hyman argues that since Rav is nowhere mentioned by his father’s name, it seems that this is the one mentioned in Gittin 32a as Rabbah bar Aivu in the name of Rav Sheshet. Rabbi Shlomo Buber, in Otzar HaSifrut, year 4, p. 168, holds that he is Rabbi Abba bar Avina.

notes.text: Saved Torat Emet Shemot Rabbah 42:4 supplies the connected Abba bar Aivu chain, supporting the expansion of the garbled supplied פמ״כ־ד. Rav’s alleged absence under his father’s name is Hyman’s negative observation and argument, not an independent exhaustive finding.

The consulted Gittin 32a has Rabbah bar Aivu in Rav Sheshet’s name and an alternative Rabbah bar Avuha. Hyman’s identification and his report of Buber’s view in Otzar HaSifrut remain attributed; that exact bibliographical page was not inspected.
